Hit your goals at Berkeley Dining.

CalSwipes shows today's dining hall menus with calories and macros, then builds meals that fit your goals.

Download on the App Store Free for iPhone

Today's menus

Current menus for every Berkeley dining hall, with the nearest one picked for you.

Make My Meal

Set your calorie and macro targets and get a meal built from today's menu.

Track your day

Log what you eat and keep a running total of calories, protein, carbs, and fat.

Ask about your tray

Ask the assistant about the menu, a meal, or a photo of your tray.

Made at Berkeley. CalSwipes is built by two Berkeley students, Ashkon Chaghajerdi and Dylan Brown. Your profile and meal log stay on your iPhone. Questions or bugs? Get in touch.

CalSwipes is an independent app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the University of California, Berkeley.
